subject: planner: move PhysicalIndexMergeReader related logic into physical op dir (#62911)
summary: This commit is a mechanical refactor that moves `PhysicalIndexMergeReader` from `pkg/planner/core` into `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop` and updates all planner traversals (encode/flat-plan/explain dot/stringer/hints/probe-parent propagation) plus the executor builder to use the new type and renamed fields (`PartialPlansRaw`, `TablePlan`). Cost v1/v2 logic for IndexMergeReader is kept in `pkg/planner/core` as standalone functions and is wired back into the physical operator via `utilfuncp` function pointers set in `pkg/planner/core/core_init.go`. I did not find any correctness/SQL-semantic/transaction/concurrency/privilege/protocol behavior changes beyond relocation/renaming, and the key runtime contracts (executor builds requests from flattened `PartialPlans`/`TablePlans`, limit pushdown uses `PushedLimit`, dynamic partition access uses the same pruning helper) remain consistent.
